svg.title: Coupeville Velvet wiring reference
svg.desc: Bench reference in the same numbered-panel visual language as the Relay Arc wiring diagram. It maps pickup leads, three-way selector contacts, the two push-pull poles, four RC voice shunts, rear-view pots, operating states, and common ground.

g.text: MATCH IDENTICAL BOXED NET LABELS • FUNCTIONAL SWITCH CONTACTS MUST BE METERED
Electrical lead roles, not manufacturer wire colors
Join both commons at SEL; position 2 combines bridge and neck in parallel.
This is a functional contact map; identify actual selector lugs by continuity.
UP = Nashville solo; outer branch disconnected
Series R + C to GND; use true discrete throws.
Audio continues directly from BUS to jack TIP.
O-W feeds push-pull pole A common.
DOWN, knob 0 grounds BUS: master mute.
REAR VIEW • shaft away • lugs down
Source does not specify this pot’s value or taper.
M-LOW feeds push-pull pole B common.
DOWN: third lug floats; series blend.
At 0, ≈500 kΩ remains; not a hard off.
UP: third lug grounded; solo volume.
REAR VIEW • shaft away • lugs down
All five voice positions remain global in both modes.
No outer mixing resistor · no treble bleed · no tone pot.
GND = pickup returns + separate shields/cases • outer-volume CCW lug • push-pull B UP throw • RC returns • jack sleeve.
Also bond pot cases, conductive switch chassis, cavity shielding, and bridge/string ground to the same ground network.
Meter the 3-way in all positions; confirm both push-pull poles in DOWN and UP; verify 5-way P1 is open and P2–P5 select one RC branch.
Check middle pot ends: knob 10 ≈0 Ω from M-H to BUS; knob 0 ≈500 kΩ in DOWN, silence in UP. Tap-test every pickup and voice.
BENCH PROTOTYPE • pickup lead colors and physical switch lugs require the actual part guides and a meter • control/body fit unverified.
